div.head: VI As 5
div.ab: Quintum: ne intermittatur aliquod uestigium (ali[qu]a uestigatio) uel a septentrionali merca uel australi, priusquam omnis homo unam equitationem equitauerit, qui equum habeat; et qui equum non habeat, operetur domino qui equitabit pro eo uel pedes eat, donec ille domum redeat, si antea consequi non poterit.

Fifte: þæt man ne forlǽte náne ǽscan naðer ne be norðan mearce ne be suðan, ǽr ælc man hæbbe áne ráde geríden þe hors habbe; ⁊ se þe hors nabbe, wyrce þam hlaforde þe him fore ríde oððe gánge, oðð he ham cúme, buton man ǽr to rihte cuman mæge.

Fifte: Þæt man ne forlǽte náne ǽscan naðer ne be norðan mearce ne be suðan, ǽr ælc man hæbbe áne ráde geríden þe hors habbe; ⁊ se þe hors nabbe, wyrce þam hlaforde þe him fore ríde oððe gánge, oð ðæt he ham cúme, buton man ǽr to rihte cuman mæge.

Fifth : No quest shall be abandoned either on the northern or the southern boundary until every man who has a horse has ridden out once. And he who has not a horse shall go on working for his lord, when the latter is proceeding on horse-back or on foot in his stead, until he [the lord] comes home — unless justice has already been obtained.

Fifthly: that no search is to be abandoned either north of the boundary or south of it, until every man who has a horse has ridden out once; and he who has no horse is to work for the lord who rides or goes on foot instead of him, until he comes home, unless justice can be obtained earlier.

Fünftens: dass man keine Nachforschung fallen lasse, weder nördlich der Grenze noch südlich der Grenze, bevor jeder Mann, der ein Pferd besitzt, Einen Ritt geritten hat; und wer kein Pferd besitzt, arbeite für den Herrn, welcher an seiner Statt reitet oder geht, bis dieser heimkehrt, ausser wenn man [der Bestohlene schon] vorher zu seinem Rechte gelangen kann.

Fifthly: that no search be abandoned, either north of the boundary or south of the boundary, before every man who has a horse has ridden one ride; and whoever has no horse, let him work for the lord who rides or goes in his place until he comes home, unless one [the person robbed] can get his right before that.
div.note: H's ‘oðð’ stands for ‘oð’ (editors correct to ‘oð ðæt’).
